chunks: If you ask them: 'Who created the heavens and the earth, and who set the sun and the moon to work?' They will answer: 'God.' Why then do they vacillate?
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists acknowledge Allah as Creator but still worship idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the intellectual inconsistency of the mushrikun, who acknowledge Allah as the sole Creator (Khaliq) and Sustainer (Rabb) yet fail to extend exclusive worship (Ibadah) to Him. It serves as a foundational argument for Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah, demonstrating that recognizing divine power over the cosmos logically necessitates submission to His will, a theme frequently explored in the commentaries of Al-Tabarsi and Al-Majlisi.
